# Project Notes

- This is a Vietnamese React + TypeScript application built with Vite.
- Keep lesson data, starter code, and expected test cases together in `src/App.tsx`.
- Python runs client-side through Pyodide loaded from jsDelivr; no Python backend is required.
- Keep the learning workspace responsive and follow the existing green, warm-neutral visual system in `src/App.css` and `src/index.css`.
- Run `npm run build` to verify TypeScript and the production bundle.
